svg.title: Drabr Chtor Terrestrial Survey Vessel - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 110-111, PDF 111-112. Combined two-deck outline retains long rounded tapered forebody, straight parallel main hull and small swept aft wings with exposed twin-drive stern. Lower cargo deck fits within the broad main hull. Illustration corroborates narrow tapered survey craft and modest rear aerofoils. Interior docking openings remain solid hull projection.
